policy_details.policy_summary: This scheme provides flexible and competitive financial incentives to Large (investment >INR 50-300 Cr), Mega (>INR 300-1000 Cr), and Ultra Mega (>INR 1000 Cr) manufacturing and eligible service enterprises in Karnataka. Investors can choose a Base Subsidy of either a Capital Expenditure Subsidy (10% to 25% of Value of Fixed Assets disbursed over 5 years) or a Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) (1.0% to 2.5% of Net Sales Turnover for 7 years, capped at 30% to 60% of VFA). Additional top-up subsidies are provided for units in backward taluks as per the Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report. Over the base subsidy, enterprises can avail Booster Subsidies for generating extra employment (7.5% to 15%), high women workforce participation (7.5% to 15%), and co-location of R&D and manufacturing units (10%). Additional support includes Stamp Duty exemption (75% to 100%), concessional registration charges (INR 1 per INR 1000), 100% reimbursement of land conversion fees, and an Affordable Industrial Dormitory Subsidy for Ultra Mega investors (up to INR 1 Cr per 1,000 people). Investments above INR 1,000 Cr or in sunrise sectors are also eligible for customized incentive packages.
policy_details.benefit_headline: Choice of up to 25% Capital Expenditure Subsidy or 2.5% Production Linked Incentive (up to 60% of VFA) for 7 years, plus up to 15% booster subsidies and 100% stamp duty and land conversion fee exemptions for Large, Mega, and Ultra Mega enterprises.

special_focus_areas: Backward taluks development (Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report)

eligibility_criteria.raw_text: Further, the policy is valid for New Manufacturing Investments in Karnataka with the categories defined below. Category Large: Minimum Total Capital Investment Amount >50 ΓÇô 300 INR Crore. Mega: >300 ΓÇô 1000 INR Crore. Ultra Mega: >1000 INR Crore. Further, investments for expansion of capacity will be considered for capital expenditure of new manufacturing facilities set up by an existing enterprise for manufacturing a product that is already being manufactured with / without up-gradation of technology or the process. Further, the enterprise to be eligible for incentives under the expansion program must increase the capital expenditure by at least 25% of the existing fixed investment. Due to advancements in the Artificial Intelligence as well as industry focus on Automation to increase productivity, the minimum employment thresholds have been rationalized. Large (50-300): Minimum Investment 50 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore (Minimum Employment: 25 - 500). Mega (300-1000): Minimum Investment 300 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore (Minimum Employment: 25 - 500). Ultra Mega (1000+): Minimum Investment 1000 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 500+ (Additional 6 jobs per 50 Cr). Incentives and concessions under this policy shall primarily be available only for Manufacturing Enterprises / Industries and specified categories of service enterprises as listed in Annexure 4. Employment Criteria for enterprises availing incentives and concessions under Industrial Policy 2025-30 are as follows: i) All new industrial investment projects shall create the maximum possible direct employment opportunities with a minimum employment of 70% to Kannadigas on an overall basis and 100% in the case of Group D employees.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Irrespective of the location / industrial activities, enterprises as listed in Annexure 5 will not be eligible for any incentives and concessions (e.g., Breweries & Distilleries for human consumption alcohol, non-FSSAI certified Khandasari/Jaggery <1Cr, Photo Studios, Xerox/Data Entry, Fertilizer mixing, Sawmills, Tobacco products, Azoic/Reactive Dyes, Firecrackers, Ozone-depleting substances, Laundries, certain Brick-making, Poultry, Popcorn, Coffee roasting <2MT/day, Repair enterprises, Cassette recording, Cyanide, Mining, Lime kiln, X-ray/clinical labs, Mobile rigs/mixing plants, Chrysolite Asbestos, Saloon/Spas, Hotels/resorts, Vermi compost, Roof-top solar, Bottling of LPG, Bio-fuel aggregators). Investments on assets acquired under Sec 29 of SFCs Act, SARFAESI Act, DRT, etc., are not eligible unless for new expansion/diversification/modernization. Trading activity or resale of products is not eligible.

Category: Ultra Mega (1000+) | Minimum Investment: 1000 | Minimum Employment: 500+ (Additional 6 jobs per 50 Cr). All new industrial investment projects shall create the maximum possible direct employment opportunities with a minimum employment of 70% to Kannadigas on an overall basis and 100% in the case of Group D employees.

eligibility_criteria.other_requirements: For expansion/diversification/modernization, enterprise must invest additional new capital of at least 25% of existing fixed assets. Must comply with CSR obligations under Section 135 of Companies Act 2013. Contract labour engaged in production line should not exceed 40% of total labour force. In case of leased land/building, minimum 10 years registered lease required to claim subsidy on Plant & Machinery, and 20 years registered land lease to claim subsidy on building constructed by unit.
eligibility_criteria.location_requirements: Financial Incentives for Zone 3 are only limited to Bengaluru Rural (Bengaluru Urban in Zone 3 is excluded). Differential rates apply across Zone 1, Zone 2, and Zone 3, with additional benefits for Most Backward and More Backward Taluks as per Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report.
eligibility_criteria.registration_requirements: Separate registration under the GST Act for manufacturing of eligible products only. Approval from SLSWCC (investment >15 Cr to 500 Cr) or SHLCC (investment >500 Cr). Industrial Entrepreneur Memorandum (IEM) / Certificate of Incorporation / Industrial Licence.

policy_name: Financial Incentives for Large, Mega & Ultra Mega Enterprises

policy_goals: To position Karnataka as the #1 destination for High-technology manufacturing investments in Asia through equitable and sustainable development.

To establish an investor-friendly ecosystem in Karnataka by fostering a conducive manufacturing environment through collaboration with the industry and developing human capital to meet the industry's demands.
Attracting investments of INR 7,50,000 Cr across the sectors, generating approximately 20,00,000 new jobs during the Policy Period, and attaining leadership in sunrise sectors in the State.
Achieve an accelerated annual growth rate of 12% for the manufacturing sector with an investment target of INR 7,50,000 Cr
Provide flexibility in incentives to stimulate interest from players across the sectors targeted by Industrial Policy
Create employment opportunities for 20,00,000 people by 2030

Become a pioneer in sustainability by incentivizing green and sustainable initiatives by investors: Offer sustainability-linked incentives to promote green measures by the existing and new investors while also promoting green industrial areas

Balanced and Inclusive Regional Development of Karnataka: Differential incentives for different regions of Karnataka based on the level of industrial growth; Rationalization of minimum employment threshold with employment booster and additional incentives for women participation in the workforce
Attain Leadership in sunrise and new age sectors: Focus on innovation driver sectors like ESDM, Advanced Manufacturing, Aerospace and Defence, Future Mobility, Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality, etc
Create a seamless experience for investors by digital enablement of Single Window System and dedicated Nodal Officers
policy_details.policy_summary: This scheme provides flexible and competitive financial incentives to Large (investment >INR 50-300 Cr), Mega (>INR 300-1000 Cr), and Ultra Mega (>INR 1000 Cr) manufacturing and eligible service enterprises in Karnataka. Investors can choose a Base Subsidy of either a Capital Expenditure Subsidy (10% to 25% of Value of Fixed Assets disbursed over 5 years) or a Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) (1.0% to 2.5% of Net Sales Turnover for 7 years, capped at 30% to 60% of VFA). Additional top-up subsidies are provided for units in backward taluks as per the Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report. Over the base subsidy, enterprises can avail Booster Subsidies for generating extra employment (7.5% to 15%), high women workforce participation (7.5% to 15%), and co-location of R&D and manufacturing units (10%). Additional support includes Stamp Duty exemption (75% to 100%), concessional registration charges (INR 1 per INR 1000), 100% reimbursement of land conversion fees, and an Affordable Industrial Dormitory Subsidy for Ultra Mega investors (up to INR 1 Cr per 1,000 people). Investments above INR 1,000 Cr or in sunrise sectors are also eligible for customized incentive packages.
policy_details.benefit_headline: Choice of up to 25% Capital Expenditure Subsidy or 2.5% Production Linked Incentive (up to 60% of VFA) for 7 years, plus up to 15% booster subsidies and 100% stamp duty and land conversion fee exemptions for Large, Mega, and Ultra Mega enterprises.
policy_details.issuing_authority: Commerce & Industries Department, Government of Karnataka
special_focus_areas: Backward taluks development (Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report)

eligibility_criteria.raw_text: Further, the policy is valid for New Manufacturing Investments in Karnataka with the categories defined below. Category Large: Minimum Total Capital Investment Amount >50 ΓÇô 300 INR Crore. Mega: >300 ΓÇô 1000 INR Crore. Ultra Mega: >1000 INR Crore. Further, investments for expansion of capacity will be considered for capital expenditure of new manufacturing facilities set up by an existing enterprise for manufacturing a product that is already being manufactured with / without up-gradation of technology or the process. Further, the enterprise to be eligible for incentives under the expansion program must increase the capital expenditure by at least 25% of the existing fixed investment. Due to advancements in the Artificial Intelligence as well as industry focus on Automation to increase productivity, the minimum employment thresholds have been rationalized. Large (50-300): Minimum Investment 50 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore (Minimum Employment: 25 - 500). Mega (300-1000): Minimum Investment 300 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore (Minimum Employment: 25 - 500). Ultra Mega (1000+): Minimum Investment 1000 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 500+ (Additional 6 jobs per 50 Cr). Incentives and concessions under this policy shall primarily be available only for Manufacturing Enterprises / Industries and specified categories of service enterprises as listed in Annexure 4. Employment Criteria for enterprises availing incentives and concessions under Industrial Policy 2025-30 are as follows: i) All new industrial investment projects shall create the maximum possible direct employment opportunities with a minimum employment of 70% to Kannadigas on an overall basis and 100% in the case of Group D employees.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Irrespective of the location / industrial activities, enterprises as listed in Annexure 5 will not be eligible for any incentives and concessions (e.g., Breweries & Distilleries for human consumption alcohol, non-FSSAI certified Khandasari/Jaggery <1Cr, Photo Studios, Xerox/Data Entry, Fertilizer mixing, Sawmills, Tobacco products, Azoic/Reactive Dyes, Firecrackers, Ozone-depleting substances, Laundries, certain Brick-making, Poultry, Popcorn, Coffee roasting <2MT/day, Repair enterprises, Cassette recording, Cyanide, Mining, Lime kiln, X-ray/clinical labs, Mobile rigs/mixing plants, Chrysolite Asbestos, Saloon/Spas, Hotels/resorts, Vermi compost, Roof-top solar, Bottling of LPG, Bio-fuel aggregators). Investments on assets acquired under Sec 29 of SFCs Act, SARFAESI Act, DRT, etc., are not eligible unless for new expansion/diversification/modernization. Trading activity or resale of products is not eligible.

minimum_employees.raw_text: Category (INR Cr.): Large (50-300) | Minimum Investment (INR Cr.): 50 | Minimum Employment (# of people): 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore, Minimum Employment: 25 - 500. Category: Mega (300-1000) | Minimum Investment: 300 | Minimum Employment: 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore, Minimum Employment: 25 - 500. Category: Ultra Mega (1000+) | Minimum Investment: 1000 | Minimum Employment: 500+ (Additional 6 jobs per 50 Cr). All new industrial investment projects shall create the maximum possible direct employment opportunities with a minimum employment of 70% to Kannadigas on an overall basis and 100% in the case of Group D employees.

eligibility_criteria.other_requirements: For expansion/diversification/modernization, enterprise must invest additional new capital of at least 25% of existing fixed assets. Must comply with CSR obligations under Section 135 of Companies Act 2013. Contract labour engaged in production line should not exceed 40% of total labour force. In case of leased land/building, minimum 10 years registered lease required to claim subsidy on Plant & Machinery, and 20 years registered land lease to claim subsidy on building constructed by unit.
eligibility_criteria.location_requirements: Financial Incentives for Zone 3 are only limited to Bengaluru Rural (Bengaluru Urban in Zone 3 is excluded). Differential rates apply across Zone 1, Zone 2, and Zone 3, with additional benefits for Most Backward and More Backward Taluks as per Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report.
eligibility_criteria.registration_requirements: Separate registration under the GST Act for manufacturing of eligible products only. Approval from SLSWCC (investment >15 Cr to 500 Cr) or SHLCC (investment >500 Cr). Industrial Entrepreneur Memorandum (IEM) / Certificate of Incorporation / Industrial Licence.
special_category_benefits: Enterprises with 50%+ women in the workforce
Units in Most Backward and More Backward Taluks (Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report)

policy_name: Financial Incentives for Large, Mega & Ultra Mega Enterprises

policy_goals: To position Karnataka as the #1 destination for High-technology manufacturing investments in Asia through equitable and sustainable development.

To establish an investor-friendly ecosystem in Karnataka by fostering a conducive manufacturing environment through collaboration with the industry and developing human capital to meet the industry's demands.
Attracting investments of INR 7,50,000 Cr across the sectors, generating approximately 20,00,000 new jobs during the Policy Period, and attaining leadership in sunrise sectors in the State.
Achieve an accelerated annual growth rate of 12% for the manufacturing sector with an investment target of INR 7,50,000 Cr
Provide flexibility in incentives to stimulate interest from players across the sectors targeted by Industrial Policy
Create employment opportunities for 20,00,000 people by 2030

Become a pioneer in sustainability by incentivizing green and sustainable initiatives by investors: Offer sustainability-linked incentives to promote green measures by the existing and new investors while also promoting green industrial areas

Balanced and Inclusive Regional Development of Karnataka: Differential incentives for different regions of Karnataka based on the level of industrial growth; Rationalization of minimum employment threshold with employment booster and additional incentives for women participation in the workforce
Attain Leadership in sunrise and new age sectors: Focus on innovation driver sectors like ESDM, Advanced Manufacturing, Aerospace and Defence, Future Mobility, Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality, etc
Create a seamless experience for investors by digital enablement of Single Window System and dedicated Nodal Officers
policy_details.policy_summary: This scheme provides flexible and competitive financial incentives to Large (investment >INR 50-300 Cr), Mega (>INR 300-1000 Cr), and Ultra Mega (>INR 1000 Cr) manufacturing and eligible service enterprises in Karnataka. Investors can choose a Base Subsidy of either a Capital Expenditure Subsidy (10% to 25% of Value of Fixed Assets disbursed over 5 years) or a Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) (1.0% to 2.5% of Net Sales Turnover for 7 years, capped at 30% to 60% of VFA). Additional top-up subsidies are provided for units in backward taluks as per the Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report. Over the base subsidy, enterprises can avail Booster Subsidies for generating extra employment (7.5% to 15%), high women workforce participation (7.5% to 15%), and co-location of R&D and manufacturing units (10%). Additional support includes Stamp Duty exemption (75% to 100%), concessional registration charges (INR 1 per INR 1000), 100% reimbursement of land conversion fees, and an Affordable Industrial Dormitory Subsidy for Ultra Mega investors (up to INR 1 Cr per 1,000 people). Investments above INR 1,000 Cr or in sunrise sectors are also eligible for customized incentive packages.
policy_details.benefit_headline: Choice of up to 25% Capital Expenditure Subsidy or 2.5% Production Linked Incentive (up to 60% of VFA) for 7 years, plus up to 15% booster subsidies and 100% stamp duty and land conversion fee exemptions for Large, Mega, and Ultra Mega enterprises.
policy_details.issuing_authority: Commerce & Industries Department, Government of Karnataka
special_focus_areas: Backward taluks development (Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report)

eligibility_criteria.raw_text: Further, the policy is valid for New Manufacturing Investments in Karnataka with the categories defined below. Category Large: Minimum Total Capital Investment Amount >50 ΓÇô 300 INR Crore. Mega: >300 ΓÇô 1000 INR Crore. Ultra Mega: >1000 INR Crore. Further, investments for expansion of capacity will be considered for capital expenditure of new manufacturing facilities set up by an existing enterprise for manufacturing a product that is already being manufactured with / without up-gradation of technology or the process. Further, the enterprise to be eligible for incentives under the expansion program must increase the capital expenditure by at least 25% of the existing fixed investment. Due to advancements in the Artificial Intelligence as well as industry focus on Automation to increase productivity, the minimum employment thresholds have been rationalized. Large (50-300): Minimum Investment 50 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore (Minimum Employment: 25 - 500). Mega (300-1000): Minimum Investment 300 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore (Minimum Employment: 25 - 500). Ultra Mega (1000+): Minimum Investment 1000 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 500+ (Additional 6 jobs per 50 Cr). Incentives and concessions under this policy shall primarily be available only for Manufacturing Enterprises / Industries and specified categories of service enterprises as listed in Annexure 4. Employment Criteria for enterprises availing incentives and concessions under Industrial Policy 2025-30 are as follows: i) All new industrial investment projects shall create the maximum possible direct employment opportunities with a minimum employment of 70% to Kannadigas on an overall basis and 100% in the case of Group D employees.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Irrespective of the location / industrial activities, enterprises as listed in Annexure 5 will not be eligible for any incentives and concessions (e.g., Breweries & Distilleries for human consumption alcohol, non-FSSAI certified Khandasari/Jaggery <1Cr, Photo Studios, Xerox/Data Entry, Fertilizer mixing, Sawmills, Tobacco products, Azoic/Reactive Dyes, Firecrackers, Ozone-depleting substances, Laundries, certain Brick-making, Poultry, Popcorn, Coffee roasting <2MT/day, Repair enterprises, Cassette recording, Cyanide, Mining, Lime kiln, X-ray/clinical labs, Mobile rigs/mixing plants, Chrysolite Asbestos, Saloon/Spas, Hotels/resorts, Vermi compost, Roof-top solar, Bottling of LPG, Bio-fuel aggregators). Investments on assets acquired under Sec 29 of SFCs Act, SARFAESI Act, DRT, etc., are not eligible unless for new expansion/diversification/modernization. Trading activity or resale of products is not eligible.

policy_name: Financial Incentives for Large, Mega & Ultra Mega Enterprises

policy_goals: To position Karnataka as the #1 destination for High-technology manufacturing investments in Asia through equitable and sustainable development.

To establish an investor-friendly ecosystem in Karnataka by fostering a conducive manufacturing environment through collaboration with the industry and developing human capital to meet the industry's demands.
Attracting investments of INR 7,50,000 Cr across the sectors, generating approximately 20,00,000 new jobs during the Policy Period, and attaining leadership in sunrise sectors in the State.
Achieve an accelerated annual growth rate of 12% for the manufacturing sector with an investment target of INR 7,50,000 Cr
Provide flexibility in incentives to stimulate interest from players across the sectors targeted by Industrial Policy
Create employment opportunities for 20,00,000 people by 2030

Become a pioneer in sustainability by incentivizing green and sustainable initiatives by investors: Offer sustainability-linked incentives to promote green measures by the existing and new investors while also promoting green industrial areas

Balanced and Inclusive Regional Development of Karnataka: Differential incentives for different regions of Karnataka based on the level of industrial growth; Rationalization of minimum employment threshold with employment booster and additional incentives for women participation in the workforce
Attain Leadership in sunrise and new age sectors: Focus on innovation driver sectors like ESDM, Advanced Manufacturing, Aerospace and Defence, Future Mobility, Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality, etc
Create a seamless experience for investors by digital enablement of Single Window System and dedicated Nodal Officers
policy_details.policy_summary: This scheme provides flexible and competitive financial incentives to Large (investment >INR 50-300 Cr), Mega (>INR 300-1000 Cr), and Ultra Mega (>INR 1000 Cr) manufacturing and eligible service enterprises in Karnataka. Investors can choose a Base Subsidy of either a Capital Expenditure Subsidy (10% to 25% of Value of Fixed Assets disbursed over 5 years) or a Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) (1.0% to 2.5% of Net Sales Turnover for 7 years, capped at 30% to 60% of VFA). Additional top-up subsidies are provided for units in backward taluks as per the Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report. Over the base subsidy, enterprises can avail Booster Subsidies for generating extra employment (7.5% to 15%), high women workforce participation (7.5% to 15%), and co-location of R&D and manufacturing units (10%). Additional support includes Stamp Duty exemption (75% to 100%), concessional registration charges (INR 1 per INR 1000), 100% reimbursement of land conversion fees, and an Affordable Industrial Dormitory Subsidy for Ultra Mega investors (up to INR 1 Cr per 1,000 people). Investments above INR 1,000 Cr or in sunrise sectors are also eligible for customized incentive packages.
policy_details.benefit_headline: Choice of up to 25% Capital Expenditure Subsidy or 2.5% Production Linked Incentive (up to 60% of VFA) for 7 years, plus up to 15% booster subsidies and 100% stamp duty and land conversion fee exemptions for Large, Mega, and Ultra Mega enterprises.
policy_details.issuing_authority: Commerce & Industries Department, Government of Karnataka
special_focus_areas: Backward taluks development (Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report)

eligibility_criteria.raw_text: Further, the policy is valid for New Manufacturing Investments in Karnataka with the categories defined below. Category Large: Minimum Total Capital Investment Amount >50 ΓÇô 300 INR Crore. Mega: >300 ΓÇô 1000 INR Crore. Ultra Mega: >1000 INR Crore. Further, investments for expansion of capacity will be considered for capital expenditure of new manufacturing facilities set up by an existing enterprise for manufacturing a product that is already being manufactured with / without up-gradation of technology or the process. Further, the enterprise to be eligible for incentives under the expansion program must increase the capital expenditure by at least 25% of the existing fixed investment. Due to advancements in the Artificial Intelligence as well as industry focus on Automation to increase productivity, the minimum employment thresholds have been rationalized. Large (50-300): Minimum Investment 50 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore (Minimum Employment: 25 - 500). Mega (300-1000): Minimum Investment 300 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore (Minimum Employment: 25 - 500). Ultra Mega (1000+): Minimum Investment 1000 INR Cr., Minimum Employment: 500+ (Additional 6 jobs per 50 Cr). Incentives and concessions under this policy shall primarily be available only for Manufacturing Enterprises / Industries and specified categories of service enterprises as listed in Annexure 4. Employment Criteria for enterprises availing incentives and concessions under Industrial Policy 2025-30 are as follows: i) All new industrial investment projects shall create the maximum possible direct employment opportunities with a minimum employment of 70% to Kannadigas on an overall basis and 100% in the case of Group D employees.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Irrespective of the location / industrial activities, enterprises as listed in Annexure 5 will not be eligible for any incentives and concessions (e.g., Breweries & Distilleries for human consumption alcohol, non-FSSAI certified Khandasari/Jaggery <1Cr, Photo Studios, Xerox/Data Entry, Fertilizer mixing, Sawmills, Tobacco products, Azoic/Reactive Dyes, Firecrackers, Ozone-depleting substances, Laundries, certain Brick-making, Poultry, Popcorn, Coffee roasting <2MT/day, Repair enterprises, Cassette recording, Cyanide, Mining, Lime kiln, X-ray/clinical labs, Mobile rigs/mixing plants, Chrysolite Asbestos, Saloon/Spas, Hotels/resorts, Vermi compost, Roof-top solar, Bottling of LPG, Bio-fuel aggregators). Investments on assets acquired under Sec 29 of SFCs Act, SARFAESI Act, DRT, etc., are not eligible unless for new expansion/diversification/modernization. Trading activity or resale of products is not eligible.

minimum_employees.raw_text: Category (INR Cr.): Large (50-300) | Minimum Investment (INR Cr.): 50 | Minimum Employment (# of people): 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore, Minimum Employment: 25 - 500. Category: Mega (300-1000) | Minimum Investment: 300 | Minimum Employment: 50% of Actual Investment Amount in INR Crore, Minimum Employment: 25 - 500. Category: Ultra Mega (1000+) | Minimum Investment: 1000 | Minimum Employment: 500+ (Additional 6 jobs per 50 Cr). All new industrial investment projects shall create the maximum possible direct employment opportunities with a minimum employment of 70% to Kannadigas on an overall basis and 100% in the case of Group D employees.

eligibility_criteria.other_requirements: For expansion/diversification/modernization, enterprise must invest additional new capital of at least 25% of existing fixed assets. Must comply with CSR obligations under Section 135 of Companies Act 2013. Contract labour engaged in production line should not exceed 40% of total labour force. In case of leased land/building, minimum 10 years registered lease required to claim subsidy on Plant & Machinery, and 20 years registered land lease to claim subsidy on building constructed by unit.
eligibility_criteria.location_requirements: Financial Incentives for Zone 3 are only limited to Bengaluru Rural (Bengaluru Urban in Zone 3 is excluded). Differential rates apply across Zone 1, Zone 2, and Zone 3, with additional benefits for Most Backward and More Backward Taluks as per Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report.
eligibility_criteria.registration_requirements: Separate registration under the GST Act for manufacturing of eligible products only. Approval from SLSWCC (investment >15 Cr to 500 Cr) or SHLCC (investment >500 Cr). Industrial Entrepreneur Memorandum (IEM) / Certificate of Incorporation / Industrial Licence.
special_category_benefits: Enterprises with 50%+ women in the workforce
Units in Most Backward and More Backward Taluks (Dr. D.M. Nanjundappa Committee Report)

policy_details.policy_summary: This scheme provides fiscal incentives and ease-of-doing-business support for Logistics and Warehousing projects in Karnataka, which have been accorded 'Industry' status. Eligible facilities (Warehouses inside/outside industrial areas, Large and Mega Logistics Parks, Cold Storages, and Truck Terminals) meeting specified minimum area and minimum investment thresholds can avail Capital Subsidy (10% to 35% of eligible fixed capital investment depending on enterprise size and zone) in 5 equal annual installments, along with other Industrial Policy 2025-30 concessions, Industrial Power Tariff eligibility, and up to INR 5 Lakh reimbursement per project for green certifications (ISO 50001, GRIHA, LEED).
policy_details.benefit_headline: Capital subsidy on fixed capital investment (at Micro, Small, Medium, Large & Mega rates), Industrial Power Tariff, and up to Γé╣5 Lakh reimbursement for green certifications for Warehouses, Logistics Parks, Cold Storages, and Truck Terminals.
policy_details.issuing_authority: Commerce & Industries Department, Government of Karnataka
special_focus_areas: Green warehousing and EV logistics fleet

eligibility_criteria.raw_text: The minimum area and minimum investment for the different logistics and warehousing facilities to get incentives and concessions are as below: Warehouse Inside industrial area: Minimum area 20,000 sq. ft, Minimum investment 3 Rs. Cr. Warehouse Outside industrial area: Minimum area 70,000 sq. ft, Minimum investment 10 Rs. Cr. Large Logistics Park: Minimum area 20 acres, Minimum investment 100 Rs. Cr. Mega Logistics Park: Minimum area 100 acres, Minimum investment 350 Rs. Cr. Cold storages: Minimum area 10,000 sq. ft, Minimum investment 1.5 Rs. Cr. Truck terminal: Minimum area 5 acres, Minimum investment 7.5 Rs. Cr. The above logistics and warehousing facilities can avail capital subsidy under Micro, Small, Medium, Large and Mega Enterprises as applicable. Above logistics and warehousing facility will be excluded from incentives in Bengaluru Urban in Zone-3.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Logistics and warehousing facilities located in Bengaluru Urban in Zone-3 are excluded from incentives. Storage of hazardous waste is excluded from EC/agricultural zone relaxations.
eligibility_criteria.other_requirements: Must meet facility-specific minimum area and investment thresholds: Cold storage (>=10,000 sq.ft., >=Rs 1.5 Cr); Warehouse inside industrial area (>=20,000 sq.ft. plinth area at basement floor, >=Rs 3 Cr); Truck terminal (>=5 acres, >=Rs 7.5 Cr); Warehouse outside industrial area (>=70,000 sq.ft. plinth area at basement floor, >=Rs 10 Cr); Large Logistics Park (>=20 acres, >=Rs 100 Cr); Mega Logistics Park (>=100 acres, >=Rs 350 Cr). Rainwater harvesting mandatory for warehousing facilities with built-up area exceeding 1,00,000 sq.ft.
eligibility_criteria.location_requirements: Applicable across Karnataka in Zone 1, Zone 2, and Bengaluru Rural in Zone 3 (excluded in Bengaluru Urban in Zone 3).
eligibility_criteria.registration_requirements: Approval from DLSWCC/SLSWCC/SHLCC and IEM/Udyam Registration.

policy_details.policy_summary: This scheme encourages private developers, PPP entities, and industry associations/institutes to build world-class industrial parks, Ready Built Factories (RBFs), and advanced technology Centres of Excellence in Karnataka. Private Industrial Park developers meeting minimum land extent thresholds (5 to 200 acres) receive a 10% Capital Subsidy on building and trunk infrastructure VFA (disbursed over 3 years), 100% Stamp Duty exemption, concessional registration charges (INR 1/1000) across all zones, 50% capital subsidy for park-level CETPs (up to INR 5 Cr) and STPs (up to INR 1 Cr), and a provision to form SPVs with KIADB (<25% equity stake in raw land). Additionally, the State provides a grant of INR 100 Crore for setting up a Centre of Excellence (CoE) for Industry 5.0 at Bengaluru and regional centres, and a 50% capital subsidy up to INR 500 Lakh per center for the first 5 Direct Digital Manufacturing common facility units.
policy_details.benefit_headline: 10% Capital Subsidy on infrastructure VFA and 100% Stamp Duty exemption for Private Industrial Park developers, Γé╣100 Crore grant for Industry 5.0 Centre of Excellence, and 50% subsidy up to Γé╣5 Crore per Direct Digital Manufacturing center.
policy_details.issuing_authority: Commerce & Industries Department, Government of Karnataka

eligibility_criteria.raw_text: Support for Private industrial parks will be eligible based on the following table on the minimum extent developed. The project can be either in PPP mode or private development and must be approved under SLSWCC/SHLCC. Category of Infrastructure: Knowledge-Based Industries / Flatted Factories: Minimum Extent 5 Acres. Logistics: Minimum Extent 20 Acres. Multi/Sector Specific Industrial Parks: Minimum Extent 50 Acres. Integrated Industrial Parks: Minimum Extent 200 Acres. Centre of Excellence for Industry 5.0 shall be set up in the State with the help of industry associations, institutes having the requisite capacity, and any leading academic technical institution of the State... subject to the condition that such CoE use only existing building/s and taking up of new construction will not be considered.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: For Industry 5.0 Centre of Excellence, taking up of new building construction will not be considered (must use existing buildings). Guest/rest houses, decorative arch entrances, high-rise compound walls, and deposits to utility agencies (ESCOM/KEB/BWSSB/PWD) are excluded from infrastructure VFA.
eligibility_criteria.other_requirements: Minimum land extent for Private Industrial Parks: 5 acres for Knowledge-Based Industries / Flatted Factories; 20 acres for Logistics; 50 acres for Multi/Sector Specific Industrial Parks; 200 acres for Integrated Industrial Parks. For Direct Digital Manufacturing centers, common facilities must be housed and managed by industry associations/institutes on a pay-per-use basis.
eligibility_criteria.location_requirements: Applicable across all Zones (Zone 1, 2, and 3) in Karnataka.
eligibility_criteria.registration_requirements: Project must be approved under SLSWCC/SHLCC. Layout plan approved by KIADB/Local Authority, Consent for Operation (CFO) from KSPCB, and Environment Clearance Certificate (ECC) from DFEE/MOEF.

incentive_details.description: Capital subsidy of 50% limited to INR 500 Lakh per center for the first five units in the State set up with the help of industry associations/institutes to act as pay-per-use common facilities and repositories for Direct Digital Manufacturing.

policy_details.policy_summary: This scheme promotes the establishment of healthcare enterprises (hospitals with diagnostic labs) as critical civic amenities in industrial parks/estates across Karnataka. Eligible hospitals set up over at least 1 acre in an Industrial Area/estate with at least 50 beds receive 100% reimbursement of stamp duty paid on loan agreements (for initial 5 years) and lease/sale deeds executed in respect of industrial plots, sheds, or tenements allotted by KIADB.
policy_details.benefit_headline: 100% reimbursement of Stamp Duty on loan agreements and KIADB land lease/sale deeds for hospitals with diagnostic labs (minimum 50 beds on at least 1 acre) in industrial areas.
policy_details.issuing_authority: Commerce & Industries Department, Government of Karnataka

eligibility_criteria.raw_text: Healthcare enterprises form a critical part of the civic amenities required to create a thriving industrial ecosystem. Eligible healthcare enterprises can be defined as hospitals with diagnostic labs set up over at least 1 acre in Industrial Area/estate and having at least 50 beds. Ayurvedic hospitals shall not be eligible for incentives.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Ayurvedic hospitals shall not be eligible for incentives. Healthcare facilities in KIADB/KSSIDC areas are excluded from Base Subsidy or Capital Subsidy (Annexure 4). X-ray clinics, standalone clinical/pathological laboratories, and scanning/MRI testing enterprises are not eligible (Annexure 5).
eligibility_criteria.other_requirements: Must be a hospital with diagnostic labs set up over at least 1 acre of land and having at least 50 beds.
eligibility_criteria.location_requirements: Must be set up over at least 1 acre in an Industrial Area/estate (KIADB).
eligibility_criteria.registration_requirements: Registration with Government of Karnataka/GOI, SLSWCC/SHLCC/Health Dept approval, and Certificate from Concerned District Health Department Officer.

incentive_details.description: Reimbursement of stamp duty paid in respect of loan agreements, credit deeds, mortgage and hypothecation deeds executed for availing loans from specified financial institutions for the initial period of 5 years, and for lease deeds, lease-cum-sale, sub-lease, and absolute sale deeds executed in respect of industrial plots, sheds, and industrial tenements by KIADB.
incentive_details.benefit_headline: 100% reimbursement of stamp duty paid on loan deeds (for 5 years) and KIADB plot/shed lease and sale deeds for eligible hospitals in industrial parks.

policy_details.policy_summary: This scheme incentivizes industrial units (both MSMEs and Large/Mega/Ultra Mega enterprises) to adopt green, eco-friendly, and sustainable practices, decarbonize operations, and establish waste recycling infrastructure. It provides a 50% equipment/certification cost subsidy for Environmental Infrastructure (ETPs, CETPs, hazardous waste disposal), Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD), Air Pollution Control measures, Energy Efficiency measures, and Electrification of low-temperature thermal processes/Li-ion BESS, as well as a 10% subsidy for converting industrial passenger/utility vehicles to EVs (overall capped at 10% of VFA). special_focus_areas: Circular economy and waste recycling (plastic, e-waste, biomedical waste)

policy_goals: To position Karnataka as the #1 destination for High-technology manufacturing investments in Asia through equitable and sustainable development.

To establish an investor-friendly ecosystem in Karnataka by fostering a conducive manufacturing environment through collaboration with the industry and developing human capital to meet the industry's demands.
Attracting investments of INR 7,50,000 Cr across the sectors, generating approximately 20,00,000 new jobs during the Policy Period, and attaining leadership in sunrise sectors in the State.
Achieve an accelerated annual growth rate of 12% for the manufacturing sector with an investment target of INR 7,50,000 Cr
Provide flexibility in incentives to stimulate interest from players across the sectors targeted by Industrial Policy
Create employment opportunities for 20,00,000 people by 2030

Become a pioneer in sustainability by incentivizing green and sustainable initiatives by investors: Offer sustainability-linked incentives to promote green measures by the existing and new investors while also promoting green industrial areas

Balanced and Inclusive Regional Development of Karnataka: Differential incentives for different regions of Karnataka based on the level of industrial growth; Rationalization of minimum employment threshold with employment booster and additional incentives for women participation in the workforce
Attain Leadership in sunrise and new age sectors: Focus on innovation driver sectors like ESDM, Advanced Manufacturing, Aerospace and Defence, Future Mobility, Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality, etc
Create a seamless experience for investors by digital enablement of Single Window System and dedicated Nodal Officers
policy_details.policy_summary: This scheme incentivizes industrial units (both MSMEs and Large/Mega/Ultra Mega enterprises) to adopt green, eco-friendly, and sustainable practices, decarbonize operations, and establish waste recycling infrastructure. It provides a 50% equipment/certification cost subsidy for Environmental Infrastructure (ETPs, CETPs, hazardous waste disposal), Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD), Air Pollution Control measures, Energy Efficiency measures, and Electrification of low-temperature thermal processes/Li-ion BESS, as well as a 10% subsidy for converting industrial passenger/utility vehicles to EVs (overall capped at 10% of VFA). It also offers KSPCB-CII GreenCo Rating awards (up to INR 10 Lakh), additional boosters on Base Subsidy (3% to 12.5%) for GreenCo-certified Large & above enterprises, and a one-time 50% capital subsidy up to INR 5 Crore for establishing plastic, e-waste, biomedical waste recycling, and waste-to-energy facilities.

special_focus_areas: Circular economy and waste recycling (plastic, e-waste, biomedical waste)

policy_name: Karnataka Information Technology Policy 2025-2030

policy_goals: To retain leadership in the IT sector through pioneering AI capabilities, fostering the development of other emerging technologies, promoting balanced and holistic regional growth, and positioning the State as a preferred global destination for innovation and investment.
To increase the IT SectorΓÇÖs contribution to Gross State Value Added from 26% to 36%.

Drive significant IT investments with special focus on AI and other new technologies in emerging cities such as Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubbali Dharwad Belgavi, Tumakuru, Kalaburagi, and Shivamogga, to facilitate balanced growth and foster inclusive development.
Enable cross-sector R&D partnerships between industry, academia, and government to promote sustainable innovation and product development.
Elevate KarnatakaΓÇÖs brand globally as ΓÇÿDeep tech innovation destinationΓÇÖ, building on its legacy as IndiaΓÇÖs premier IT and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs.
To achieve generation of 90+ Lakh direct and indirect employment in the State during the policy period.
To increase software exports from INR 4.09 lakh crores to INR 11.5 lakh crores by 2030 reinforcing KarnatakaΓÇÖs leadership in global tech markets.
policy_details.policy_summary: The Karnataka Information Technology Policy 2025-2030, notified on 17th November 2025, aims to retain Karnataka's leadership in the IT/ITeS sector, pioneer AI and emerging technologies, and drive regionally balanced growth across 'Beyond Bengaluru' hubs (Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi-Dharwad, Belagavi, Tumakuru, Kalaburagi, and Shivamogga). Anchored on the F.R.A.M.E framework (Frontier & Emerging Tech, Regional Development, Alignment with National/Global Strategies, Market Creation, Enterprise Facilitation), it targets 90+ lakh direct/indirect jobs and increasing software exports to Γé╣11.5 lakh crores by 2030. It provides a comprehensive suite of 16 fiscal incentives and several non-fiscal concessions for New and Expanding IT/ITeS units, Global Capability Centres (GCCs), Infrastructure/Co-working space developers, State Universities/Colleges, and Industry Associations. Key fiscal offerings include 40% R&D expenditure subsidy up to Γé╣5 Crores, 20% CAPEX support up to Γé╣5 Crores (plus 50% stamp duty reimbursement) for new IT/ITeS Parks Beyond Bengaluru, workforce subsidies (internship stipend, recruitment assistance up to Γé╣7 Crores, relocation reimbursement, Γé╣3,000/month EPF reimbursement, skilling cost reimbursement, faculty development support), operational subsidies (50% rental assistance up to Γé╣50 Lakhs, quality certification & patent fee reimbursements, switch to industrial power tariff, 100% electricity duty reimbursement for 5 years, 30% property tax reimbursement for 3 years, 25% internet expense reimbursement), and customized packages for Mega Projects (investment > Γé╣300 Crores).
policy_details.benefit_headline: Up to 40% R&D subsidy (max Γé╣5 Cr), 50% rental assistance (max Γé╣50 Lakhs), industrial power tariff, and extensive workforce/operational subsidies for IT/ITeS units and GCCs in Karnataka (with enhanced benefits Beyond Bengaluru).
policy_details.issuing_authority: Department of Electronics, Information Technology, Biotechnology, and Science & Technology, Government of Karnataka
special_focus_areas: Beyond Bengaluru regional development (Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi-Dharwad, Belagavi, Tumakuru, Kalaburagi, Shivamogga)
Women in Global Tech Missions Fellowship and women employment
Deep Tech and Emerging Technologies (AI, Quantum Computing, Cybersecurity, Web3, Blockchain)

eligibility_criteria.raw_text:
5. Eligibility Criteria for Availing Incentives
Applicants are required to fulfil the following eligibility criteria to avail incentives.
Nature of Business
1. Eligible IT/ITeS Units shall include the following:
i. Unit registered as an IT/ITeS Unit as defined in the policy)
(or)
ii. Entities registered as Global Capability Centres (GCCs) that are headquartered in India, either operational or under establishment in the State of Karnataka and engaged in providing IT/ITeS services to their parent entities headquartered in India and/or their group affiliates.
Both New IT/ITeS Units and Existing IT/ITeS Units undertaking expansion shall be eligible for incentives under this policy, unless mentioned otherwise for any specific incentive available to IT/ITeS Units.
2. Infrastructure Developer/ Co-working space developer
Entities registered as an Infrastructure Developer/ Co-working space developer should be engaged in the construction of infrastructure facilities / office space on lease/rental arrangements.
Location
Incentives shall be available to Eligible IT/ITeS Units in Karnataka set-up by an entity which meets the criteria of an applicant as defined in the policy.
Employment
i. A minimum employment threshold of 10 employees in Beyond Bengaluru region and 25 employees in Bengaluru shall apply for availing incentives under this policy.
ii. The IT/ ITeS entity must have at least 50% of its total workforce (employees) based in Karnataka. This count shall exclude contract employees. This requirement does not apply to Infrastructure Developers or Co-working Space Developers.
Validity
The policy is valid for a period of 5 years from the date of its notification or till a new policy is announced.
Note
Applicants/ Units that applied for availing incentives under the previously policy (i.e., Karnataka IT Policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025) will not be eligible to claim incentives under this policy, unless eligible as an ΓÇÿexpansionΓÇÖ unit as defined under this policy.
Separately, Applicants/ Units that obtained registration under the Karnataka IT policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025, but did not avail incentives, shall be eligible to avail only the following incentives, under the previous policy (i.e., Karnataka IT policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025), subject to fulfilment of prescribed conditions.
1. Reimbursement of PF/ ESI
2. Lease/ Rental reimbursement
Such applicants (registered during the Karnataka IT policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025) shall file the claim of incentives within 18 months from the date of notification of this policy

Definitions:
Applicant: An entity incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013; a Partnership Firm registered under the Partnership Act, 1932; or a Limited Liability Partnership under the LLP Act, 2008. Includes State Government Universities, affiliated colleges, and industry associations.
Expansion: An existing IT/ ITeS Unit located within Karnataka which has already commenced commercial operations before the date of notification of this policy and undertakes further expansion of its operations by generating additional employment of at least 50% of its existing employees (as on the date prior to notification of this policy) or 200 employees, whichever is lower. Provided that minimum of 50 additional employment should be generated to qualify as an ΓÇÿExpansionΓÇÖ unit.
New IT/ITeS Unit: Means an IT/ITeS Unit in Karnataka which has commenced or will commence commercial operations after the date of notification of the Policy (i.e. 17.11.2025). The term also includes an entity that has an existing IT/ITeS unit in the state (i.e., prior to the date of notification of this policy i.e., 17.11. 2025) and is setting up a new IT/ITeS unit in a different premise or location within Karnataka, then such new unit shall be eligible for incentives as New IT/ITeS Unit.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Applicants/ Units that applied for availing incentives under the previously policy (i.e., Karnataka IT Policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025) will not be eligible to claim incentives under this policy, unless eligible as an ΓÇÿexpansionΓÇÖ unit as defined under this policy. If the previously availed incentive from KITS or any other department of the Government of Karnataka falls outside the current policy period, the applicant will not be eligible to receive the same incentive again under this policy. Employee count excludes all members of the Board of Directors of the Company, all Key Managerial Personnel (KMPs) as defined in the Companies Act, 2013, and contractual employees, apprentices, interns etc. who are not employed by the entity on its payroll.

minimum_employees.raw_text: i. A minimum employment threshold of 10 employees in Beyond Bengaluru region and 25 employees in Bengaluru shall apply for availing incentives under this policy. ii. The IT/ ITeS entity must have at least 50% of its total workforce (employees) based in Karnataka. This count shall exclude contract employees. This requirement does not apply to Infrastructure Developers or Co-working Space Developers. Expansion: An existing IT/ ITeS Unit located within Karnataka which has already commenced commercial operations before the date of notification of this policy and undertakes further expansion of its operations by generating additional employment of at least 50% of its existing employees (as on the date prior to notification of this policy) or 200 employees, whichever is lower. Provided that minimum of 50 additional employment should be generated to qualify as an ΓÇÿExpansionΓÇÖ unit.

eligibility_criteria.other_requirements: Applicant must be an entity incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013; a Partnership Firm registered under the Partnership Act, 1932; or a Limited Liability Partnership under the LLP Act, 2008 (also includes State Government Universities, affiliated colleges, and industry associations). Eligible units include IT/ITeS units, Global Capability Centres (GCCs) headquartered in India and operational/under establishment in Karnataka, and Infrastructure Developers / Co-working space developers.
eligibility_criteria.location_requirements: Unit must be set up in Karnataka (Bengaluru is defined as Zone 3 as per the prevailing Karnataka Industrial Policy; Beyond Bengaluru is defined as areas located outside Zone 3). At least 50% of the IT/ITeS entity's total workforce (excluding contract employees) must be based in Karnataka.
eligibility_criteria.registration_requirements: All applicants (except Industry Associations for the Events and Conferences incentive) must register with Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KITS) on the portal https://eitbt.karnataka.gov.in/ by paying a one-time registration processing fee of INR 10,000 plus applicable GST (no additional registration fee for additional units). Also requires Shops and Establishment Certificate under The Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act 1961, GST Registration Certificate, and PAN Card.
special_category_benefits: Women professionals and candidates (1000 mid-career women trained under Women in Global Tech Missions Fellowship; entities encouraged to provide equitable opportunities to women candidates in internships; permission to employ women in all three shifts 24x7)

incentive_details.description: Financial assistance is provided by GoK to Eligible IT/ITeS Units (New/Expansion) in Bengaluru and Beyond Bengaluru for the establishment of Advanced Innovation and R&D Setups. Eligible R&D expenditure includes expenses towards R&D of emerging technologies, design & engineering, product development, software development, testing and measuring instruments, prototypes, design tools, software cost, license fee, IPR/Patents/Copyrights, compliance/regulatory testing, capitalized value of computers/servers/workstations/networking equipment used for R&D, plus up to 10% of manpower expenses (salary and DA) and non-creditable taxes/duties.
incentive_details.benefit_headline: 40% reimbursement of eligible R&D expenditure up to Γé╣5 Crores for New and Expanding IT/ITeS units across Karnataka.
incentive_details.application_process: Register with KITS on https://eitbt.karnataka.gov.in/, submit Form 7.3.1 along with Detailed Project Report (DPR), CA/Cost Accountant certificate (with UDIN), MoU with industry partners (if any), IP proof, and invoices. Evaluated by R&D Sub-Committee (virtual/physical inspection) and sanctioned by Respective Committee.

quantified_benefits.cap_raw: maximum up to INR 5 Crores
quantified_benefits.conditions: Claimed only once under this policy (can be availed in phases by applying separately for each phase). Only expenditure incurred or proposed to be incurred after the date of notification of the policy by R&D unit(s) located in Karnataka shall be considered.
quantified_benefits.description: 40% reimbursement of eligible R&D expenditure, capped at INR 5 Crores
quantified_benefits.source_text: Applicability: Eligible IT/ ITeS Units. (New/ Expansion) | Geographical coverage: Bengaluru and Beyond Bengaluru | Description: 40% of the eligible R&D expenditure, maximum up to INR 5 Crores, whichever is lower. This incentive shall be claimed by an eligible unit only once under this policy.
quantified_benefits.applicable_to: Eligible IT/ ITeS Units (New / Expansion) in Bengaluru and Beyond Bengaluru

incentive_details.application_deadline: During the Policy Period
incentive_details.application_authority: Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KITS) / R&D Sub-Committee / Respective Committee (Working Committee for claims up to Γé╣2.5 Cr; Executive Committee for claims > Γé╣2.5 Cr)
incentive_details.incentive_specific_eligibility: Applicable to Eligible IT/ITeS Units (New/Expansion) in Bengaluru and Beyond Bengaluru. R&D activities must be related to the line of business of the unit and facilities must be operational within the stipulated timeframe.

5. Eligibility Criteria for Availing Incentives
Applicants are required to fulfil the following eligibility criteria to avail incentives.
Nature of Business
1. Eligible IT/ITeS Units shall include the following:
i. Unit registered as an IT/ITeS Unit as defined in the policy)
(or)
ii. Entities registered as Global Capability Centres (GCCs) that are headquartered in India, either operational or under establishment in the State of Karnataka and engaged in providing IT/ITeS services to their parent entities headquartered in India and/or their group affiliates.
Both New IT/ITeS Units and Existing IT/ITeS Units undertaking expansion shall be eligible for incentives under this policy, unless mentioned otherwise for any specific incentive available to IT/ITeS Units.
2. Infrastructure Developer/ Co-working space developer
Entities registered as an Infrastructure Developer/ Co-working space developer should be engaged in the construction of infrastructure facilities / office space on lease/rental arrangements.
Location
Incentives shall be available to Eligible IT/ITeS Units in Karnataka set-up by an entity which meets the criteria of an applicant as defined in the policy.
Employment
i. A minimum employment threshold of 10 employees in Beyond Bengaluru region and 25 employees in Bengaluru shall apply for availing incentives under this policy.
ii. The IT/ ITeS entity must have at least 50% of its total workforce (employees) based in Karnataka. This count shall exclude contract employees. This requirement does not apply to Infrastructure Developers or Co-working Space Developers.
Validity
The policy is valid for a period of 5 years from the date of its notification or till a new policy is announced.

policy_name: Karnataka Information Technology Policy 2025-2030

policy_goals: To retain leadership in the IT sector through pioneering AI capabilities, fostering the development of other emerging technologies, promoting balanced and holistic regional growth, and positioning the State as a preferred global destination for innovation and investment.
To increase the IT SectorΓÇÖs contribution to Gross State Value Added from 26% to 36%.

Drive significant IT investments with special focus on AI and other new technologies in emerging cities such as Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubbali Dharwad Belgavi, Tumakuru, Kalaburagi, and Shivamogga, to facilitate balanced growth and foster inclusive development.
Enable cross-sector R&D partnerships between industry, academia, and government to promote sustainable innovation and product development.
Elevate KarnatakaΓÇÖs brand globally as ΓÇÿDeep tech innovation destinationΓÇÖ, building on its legacy as IndiaΓÇÖs premier IT and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs.
To achieve generation of 90+ Lakh direct and indirect employment in the State during the policy period.
To increase software exports from INR 4.09 lakh crores to INR 11.5 lakh crores by 2030 reinforcing KarnatakaΓÇÖs leadership in global tech markets.
policy_details.policy_summary: The Karnataka Information Technology Policy 2025-2030, notified on 17th November 2025, aims to retain Karnataka's leadership in the IT/ITeS sector, pioneer AI and emerging technologies, and drive regionally balanced growth across 'Beyond Bengaluru' hubs (Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi-Dharwad, Belagavi, Tumakuru, Kalaburagi, and Shivamogga). Anchored on the F.R.A.M.E framework (Frontier & Emerging Tech, Regional Development, Alignment with National/Global Strategies, Market Creation, Enterprise Facilitation), it targets 90+ lakh direct/indirect jobs and increasing software exports to Γé╣11.5 lakh crores by 2030. It provides a comprehensive suite of 16 fiscal incentives and several non-fiscal concessions for New and Expanding IT/ITeS units, Global Capability Centres (GCCs), Infrastructure/Co-working space developers, State Universities/Colleges, and Industry Associations. Key fiscal offerings include 40% R&D expenditure subsidy up to Γé╣5 Crores, 20% CAPEX support up to Γé╣5 Crores (plus 50% stamp duty reimbursement) for new IT/ITeS Parks Beyond Bengaluru, workforce subsidies (internship stipend, recruitment assistance up to Γé╣7 Crores, relocation reimbursement, Γé╣3,000/month EPF reimbursement, skilling cost reimbursement, faculty development support), operational subsidies (50% rental assistance up to Γé╣50 Lakhs, quality certification & patent fee reimbursements, switch to industrial power tariff, 100% electricity duty reimbursement for 5 years, 30% property tax reimbursement for 3 years, 25% internet expense reimbursement), and customized packages for Mega Projects (investment > Γé╣300 Crores).
policy_details.benefit_headline: Up to 40% R&D subsidy (max Γé╣5 Cr), 50% rental assistance (max Γé╣50 Lakhs), industrial power tariff, and extensive workforce/operational subsidies for IT/ITeS units and GCCs in Karnataka (with enhanced benefits Beyond Bengaluru).
policy_details.issuing_authority: Department of Electronics, Information Technology, Biotechnology, and Science & Technology, Government of Karnataka
special_focus_areas: Beyond Bengaluru regional development (Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi-Dharwad, Belagavi, Tumakuru, Kalaburagi, Shivamogga)
Women in Global Tech Missions Fellowship and women employment
Deep Tech and Emerging Technologies (AI, Quantum Computing, Cybersecurity, Web3, Blockchain)

5. Eligibility Criteria for Availing Incentives
Applicants are required to fulfil the following eligibility criteria to avail incentives.
Nature of Business
1. Eligible IT/ITeS Units shall include the following:
i. Unit registered as an IT/ITeS Unit as defined in the policy)
(or)
ii. Entities registered as Global Capability Centres (GCCs) that are headquartered in India, either operational or under establishment in the State of Karnataka and engaged in providing IT/ITeS services to their parent entities headquartered in India and/or their group affiliates.
Both New IT/ITeS Units and Existing IT/ITeS Units undertaking expansion shall be eligible for incentives under this policy, unless mentioned otherwise for any specific incentive available to IT/ITeS Units.
2. Infrastructure Developer/ Co-working space developer
Entities registered as an Infrastructure Developer/ Co-working space developer should be engaged in the construction of infrastructure facilities / office space on lease/rental arrangements.
Location
Incentives shall be available to Eligible IT/ITeS Units in Karnataka set-up by an entity which meets the criteria of an applicant as defined in the policy.
Employment
i. A minimum employment threshold of 10 employees in Beyond Bengaluru region and 25 employees in Bengaluru shall apply for availing incentives under this policy.
ii. The IT/ ITeS entity must have at least 50% of its total workforce (employees) based in Karnataka. This count shall exclude contract employees. This requirement does not apply to Infrastructure Developers or Co-working Space Developers.

5. Eligibility Criteria for Availing Incentives
Applicants are required to fulfil the following eligibility criteria to avail incentives.
Nature of Business
1. Eligible IT/ITeS Units shall include the following:
i. Unit registered as an IT/ITeS Unit as defined in the policy)
(or)
ii. Entities registered as Global Capability Centres (GCCs) that are headquartered in India, either operational or under establishment in the State of Karnataka and engaged in providing IT/ITeS services to their parent entities headquartered in India and/or their group affiliates.
Both New IT/ITeS Units and Existing IT/ITeS Units undertaking expansion shall be eligible for incentives under this policy, unless mentioned otherwise for any specific incentive available to IT/ITeS Units.
2. Infrastructure Developer/ Co-working space developer
Entities registered as an Infrastructure Developer/ Co-working space developer should be engaged in the construction of infrastructure facilities / office space on lease/rental arrangements.
Location
Incentives shall be available to Eligible IT/ITeS Units in Karnataka set-up by an entity which meets the criteria of an applicant as defined in the policy.
Employment
i. A minimum employment threshold of 10 employees in Beyond Bengaluru region and 25 employees in Bengaluru shall apply for availing incentives under this policy.
ii. The IT/ ITeS entity must have at least 50% of its total workforce (employees) based in Karnataka. This count shall exclude contract employees. This requirement does not apply to Infrastructure Developers or Co-working Space Developers.
Validity
The policy is valid for a period of 5 years from the date of its notification or till a new policy is announced.
Note
Applicants/ Units that applied for availing incentives under the previously policy (i.e., Karnataka IT Policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025) will not be eligible to claim incentives under this policy, unless eligible as an ΓÇÿexpansionΓÇÖ unit as defined under this policy.
Separately, Applicants/ Units that obtained registration under the Karnataka IT policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025, but did not avail incentives, shall be eligible to avail only the following incentives, under the previous policy (i.e., Karnataka IT policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025), subject to fulfilment of prescribed conditions.
1. Reimbursement of PF/ ESI
2. Lease/ Rental reimbursement
Such applicants (registered during the Karnataka IT policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025) shall file the claim of incentives within 18 months from the date of notification of this policy

Provided that minimum of 50 additional employment should be generated to qualify as an ΓÇÿExpansionΓÇÖ unit.

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Applicants/ Units that applied for availing incentives under the previously policy (i.e., Karnataka IT Policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025) will not be eligible to claim incentives under this policy, unless eligible as an ΓÇÿexpansionΓÇÖ unit as defined under this policy. policy_goals: To retain leadership in the IT sector through pioneering AI capabilities, fostering the development of other emerging technologies, promoting balanced and holistic regional growth, and positioning the State as a preferred global destination for innovation and investment.
To increase the IT SectorΓÇÖs contribution to Gross State Value Added from 26% to 36%.

Drive significant IT investments with special focus on AI and other new technologies in emerging cities such as Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubbali Dharwad Belgavi, Tumakuru, Kalaburagi, and Shivamogga, to facilitate balanced growth and foster inclusive development.

Elevate KarnatakaΓÇÖs brand globally as ΓÇÿDeep tech innovation destinationΓÇÖ, building on its legacy as IndiaΓÇÖs premier IT and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs.

To increase software exports from INR 4.09 lakh crores to INR 11.5 lakh crores by 2030 reinforcing KarnatakaΓÇÖs leadership in global tech markets.
policy_details.policy_summary: The Karnataka Information Technology Policy 2025-2030, notified on 17th November 2025, aims to retain Karnataka's leadership in the IT/ITeS sector, pioneer AI and emerging technologies, and drive regionally balanced growth across 'Beyond Bengaluru' hubs (Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi-Dharwad, Belagavi, Tumakuru, Kalaburagi, and Shivamogga). Anchored on the F.R.A.M.E framework (Frontier & Emerging Tech, Regional Development, Alignment with National/Global Strategies, Market Creation, Enterprise Facilitation), it targets 90+ lakh direct/indirect jobs and increasing software exports to Γé╣11.5 lakh crores by 2030. It provides a comprehensive suite of 16 fiscal incentives and several non-fiscal concessions for New and Expanding IT/ITeS units, Global Capability Centres (GCCs), Infrastructure/Co-working space developers, State Universities/Colleges, and Industry Associations. Key fiscal offerings include 40% R&D expenditure subsidy up to Γé╣5 Crores, 20% CAPEX support up to Γé╣5 Crores (plus 50% stamp duty reimbursement) for new IT/ITeS Parks Beyond Bengaluru, workforce subsidies (internship stipend, recruitment assistance up to Γé╣7 Crores, relocation reimbursement, Γé╣3,000/month EPF reimbursement, skilling cost reimbursement, faculty development support), operational subsidies (50% rental assistance up to Γé╣50 Lakhs, quality certification & patent fee reimbursements, switch to industrial power tariff, 100% electricity duty reimbursement for 5 years, 30% property tax reimbursement for 3 years, 25% internet expense reimbursement), and customized packages for Mega Projects (investment > Γé╣300 Crores).

eligibility_criteria.raw_text:
5. Eligibility Criteria for Availing Incentives
Applicants are required to fulfil the following eligibility criteria to avail incentives.
Nature of Business
1. Eligible IT/ITeS Units shall include the following:
i. Unit registered as an IT/ITeS Unit as defined in the policy)
(or)
ii. Entities registered as Global Capability Centres (GCCs) that are headquartered in India, either operational or under establishment in the State of Karnataka and engaged in providing IT/ITeS services to their parent entities headquartered in India and/or their group affiliates.
Both New IT/ITeS Units and Existing IT/ITeS Units undertaking expansion shall be eligible for incentives under this policy, unless mentioned otherwise for any specific incentive available to IT/ITeS Units.
2. Infrastructure Developer/ Co-working space developer
Entities registered as an Infrastructure Developer/ Co-working space developer should be engaged in the construction of infrastructure facilities / office space on lease/rental arrangements.
Location
Incentives shall be available to Eligible IT/ITeS Units in Karnataka set-up by an entity which meets the criteria of an applicant as defined in the policy.
Employment
i. A minimum employment threshold of 10 employees in Beyond Bengaluru region and 25 employees in Bengaluru shall apply for availing incentives under this policy.
ii. The IT/ ITeS entity must have at least 50% of its total workforce (employees) based in Karnataka. This count shall exclude contract employees. This requirement does not apply to Infrastructure Developers or Co-working Space Developers.
Validity
The policy is valid for a period of 5 years from the date of its notification or till a new policy is announced.
Note
Applicants/ Units that applied for availing incentives under the previously policy (i.e., Karnataka IT Policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025) will not be eligible to claim incentives under this policy, unless eligible as an ΓÇÿexpansionΓÇÖ unit as defined under this policy.
Separately, Applicants/ Units that obtained registration under the Karnataka IT policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025, but did not avail incentives, shall be eligible to avail only the following incentives, under the previous policy (i.e., Karnataka IT policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025), subject to fulfilment of prescribed conditions.
1. Reimbursement of PF/ ESI
2. Lease/ Rental reimbursement
Such applicants (registered during the Karnataka IT policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025) shall file the claim of incentives within 18 months from the date of notification of this policy

Definitions:
Applicant: An entity incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013; a Partnership Firm registered under the Partnership Act, 1932; or a Limited Liability Partnership under the LLP Act, 2008. Includes State Government Universities, affiliated colleges, and industry associations.
Expansion: An existing IT/ ITeS Unit located within Karnataka which has already commenced commercial operations before the date of notification of this policy and undertakes further expansion of its operations by generating additional employment of at least 50% of its existing employees (as on the date prior to notification of this policy) or 200 employees, whichever is lower. Provided that minimum of 50 additional employment should be generated to qualify as an ΓÇÿExpansionΓÇÖ unit.
New IT/ITeS Unit: Means an IT/ITeS Unit in Karnataka which has commenced or will commence commercial operations after the date of notification of the Policy (i.e. 17.11.2025). The term also includes an entity that has an existing IT/ITeS unit in the state (i.e., prior to the date of notification of this policy i.e., 17.11. 2025) and is setting up a new IT/ITeS unit in a different premise or location within Karnataka, then such new unit shall be eligible for incentives as New IT/ITeS Unit.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Applicants/ Units that applied for availing incentives under the previously policy (i.e., Karnataka IT Policy 2020 ΓÇô 2025) will not be eligible to claim incentives under this policy, unless eligible as an ΓÇÿexpansionΓÇÖ unit as defined under this policy. Employee count excludes all members of the Board of Directors of the Company, all Key Managerial Personnel (KMPs) as defined in the Companies Act, 2013, and contractual employees, apprentices, interns etc. who are not employed by the entity on its payroll.

policy_goals: To retain leadership in the IT sector through pioneering AI capabilities, fostering the development of other emerging technologies, promoting balanced and holistic regional growth, and positioning the State as a preferred global destination for innovation and investment.

Enable cross-sector R&D partnerships between industry, academia, and government to promote sustainable innovation and product development.
Elevate KarnatakaΓÇÖs brand globally as ΓÇÿDeep tech innovation destinationΓÇÖ, building on its legacy as IndiaΓÇÖs premier IT and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs.
To achieve generation of 90+ Lakh direct and indirect employment in the State during the policy period.

Anchored on the F.R.A.M.E framework (Frontier & Emerging Tech, Regional Development, Alignment with National/Global Strategies, Market Creation, Enterprise Facilitation), it targets 90+ lakh direct/indirect jobs and increasing software exports to Γé╣11.5 lakh crores by 2030. It provides a comprehensive suite of 16 fiscal incentives and several non-fiscal concessions for New and Expanding IT/ITeS units, Global Capability Centres (GCCs), Infrastructure/Co-working space developers, State Universities/Colleges, and Industry Associations. Key fiscal offerings include 40% R&D expenditure subsidy up to Γé╣5 Crores, 20% CAPEX support up to Γé╣5 Crores (plus 50% stamp duty reimbursement) for new IT/ITeS Parks Beyond Bengaluru, workforce subsidies (internship stipend, recruitment assistance up to Γé╣7 Crores, relocation reimbursement, Γé╣3,000/month EPF reimbursement, skilling cost reimbursement, faculty development support), operational subsidies (50% rental assistance up to Γé╣50 Lakhs, quality certification & patent fee reimbursements, switch to industrial power tariff, 100% electricity duty reimbursement for 5 years, 30% property tax reimbursement for 3 years, 25% internet expense reimbursement), and customized packages for Mega Projects (investment > Γé╣300 Crores).
